Season 2 Draft week has begun! Come submit your country picks now!

Yes that's right we want you!! to join us on /v/modernpowers for our season 2.

/v/ModernPowers is a world strategy text-based role-playing game on Voat. You can claim a country, lead it and shape it by making posts (plays) on the subverse. The game is realism based and the starting point is the current situation on earth with all leaders, foreign relations, resources, alliances etc etc in place. You can choose your destiny from that point on and steer your own course, depending on your goals and the state of your nation these will be difficult, easy or impossible. Heavy changes will take a lot of time and effort and require multiple phases to built up your plans or story arc. Interaction with other nations can make tasks easier but can also become problematic (conflict and covert ops are a part of the game). so you can make the game as challenging as you want. We use a tier system for nations so if your limited on time or want to start out as a smaller player with less complexity there are plenty of smaller countries to claim. (Nauru, Luxembourg, Fiji, Aruba, Mauritius etc etc).

Puzzled or intrigued? Do contact the mods or join our IRC and we will be glad to answer your questions

Our first season lasted for 35 weeks (2050 ingame time) so it is save to say it is a slow paced long term game. We are starting our second season on the 12th of April and are open to new players.
